summary: Settings > Providers now lists only the providers you have set up. The rest are in an Add a provider catalog grouped into model vendors, China vendors and coding plans, relays and local runtimes, with search. Adding a custom provider now asks for a name, OpenAI or Anthropic protocol, Base URL and API key, keeps its Base URL and key editable afterwards, rejects IDs and key names that clash with built-in providers, and saves it in ~/.suzent/config with your other settings instead of the install folder.
